newsitem.title: USA: Metzler Group Q4 net up on higher demand.
newsitem.headline: Metzler Group Q4 net up on higher demand.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc on Thursday said a fourth-quarter increase in revenue and net income reflected higher demand for its consulting, information and operations management services.
The company reported that its fourth-quarter revenue rose to $5.6 million from $4.1 million in the year-earlier period. Pro forma net income reached $1.2 million compared with $684,000.
Metzler Group, which provides services to electric and gas utilities, completed an initial public offer in October.
Its shares were unchanged at 33-1/2 in midday trading on the Nasdaq.
